doc: docs/re/created_players.md. Functions and anchors for creating players through the game's own database INSERT (used by Turbo.dll's player_create call, core/sigscan.cpp built-in table); every pattern verified unique in fc27_image.bin with sig_jobs.make_sig / find, 2026-10-05. Already in realtime_signatures.json and reused: dc_create_player, dc_insert_team_player, dc_is_player_in_team, post_event, teamutil_player_moved, player_inserted_event_vtable. Offsets of the "rip" entries are the instruction start (Turbo's resolve_signature decodes the instruction there), re-checked 2026-10-05.

db_query_init.note: void Query::Init(Query* q /*0x60 bytes*/, int type /*1 select 2 delete 3 update 4 insert*/, const char* table)

db_query_set_int.note: void Query::SetInt(Query*, const char* column, int value): set-list node (+0x38) op 6, kind 0, value text "%d"

db_query_set_string.note: void Query::SetString(Query*, const char* column, const char* value) 0x14403F2E8 (kind 2, keeps the last 256 chars): byte-identical to the date setter 0x14403F348 except its call targets, so it is resolved through its call in DataController::SetEditedPlayerName (the "firstname" column)

db_query_select_field.note: void Query::Select(Query*, const char* column): select list (+0x28)

db_query_where_int.note: void Query::Where(Query*, const char* column, uint8 op /*0 =*/, int value): where list (+0x30), AND-joined

db_query_destroy.note: void Query::~Query(Query*): frees nodes (+0x58 chunks), +0x20, the table string

db_provider_execute.note: bool DbProvider::Execute(provider, Query*, void** holder) = vtable 0x14B075540 slot 1 (DataController+0 provider)

dc_set_edited_player_name.note: void DataController::SetEditedPlayerName(dc, EditedName* {+0 pid, +8 first[45], +0x35 sur[45], +0x62 common[45], +0x8F jersey[45]})

dc_update_player_attributes.note: void DataController::UpdatePlayerAttributes(dc, PlayerRecord*): UPDATE players SET 34 attributes, preferredposition1..7, role1..5, overallrating, potential, modifier

t3db_add_record.note: int T3db AddRecord(Table*, values, out idx): free list / capacity (0x13 full), field writes, IndexInsert for every index at Table+0x18, observers, Table+0x58 callbacks

t3db_index_insert.note: int IndexInsert(Index*, u16 record): filter (+0x10) then container (+0x28) insert, count +0x20

t3db_create_index.note: Index* CreateIndex(Table*, id, keyspec, filter, temp, int* err): populates from every record, appends to Table+0x18

t3db_load_table_keys.note: CreateIndex for each key definition of the table (persistent indexes, at table load 0x1406A63E0)

sql_open_result.note: the SELECT result opener: index chooser 0x1406AA8E0 with create=1

sql_choose_index.note: Cursor index choice: best existing index for the WHERE, else a temporary index built from the best partial index or a table scan

gen_create_into_club.note: the game's own 'create a player into a club': CreatePlayer, InsertTeamPlayer(pid, FreeAgents, 99, 29, 0), PlayerMoved(FA -> club), wage

event_allocator_global.note: mov rcx,[rip+x] in CreatePlayer: the global allocator pointer events are allocated from (0x14C269EA8)

event_base_vtable.note: lea rcx,[rip+x] in CreatePlayer: the event base vtable written first (0x149803AE8)
